chunks.text: Anthropic, the company behind the Claude AI models, is now a public company. Yahoo Finance reports it sold 980 million shares at $83 each, above the $70 to $78 range it had marketed. That valued Anthropic at about $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis. The BBC says shares closed 17% higher on day one at $97.17, even as the wider tech sector fell 2.4%. Third-quarter revenue hit $16.96 billion, up 47% from the prior quarter. But the company still runs at an operating loss. It has committed to spending about $895 billion, with roughly half promised by 2030. For the Gulf, watch whether this new capital flows into data centers and compute partnerships across the region.
